name: Yarisugi! Katei Kyoushi no Onee-san
original_name: ヤりすぎ!家庭教師のお姉さん
source:
When a college student hears that her cousin, our protagonist is worrying over his college entrance exams, she take charge of giving him home schooling, teaching him humanities and sciences.
Our protagonist is filled with lots of anxieties, however he asks her for help.

However what she's about to teach him doesn't just include study...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035286.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当一名大学生听说她的表弟（我们的主角）正在为他的高考而烦恼时，她负责给他提供家庭教育，教他人文和科学。
我们的主角充满了很多焦虑，但他向她寻求帮助。

然而她要教他的不仅仅是学习……

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035286.html]DLsite English[/url]]
